units.source_text: 名人和大竹七段在对局的紧张气氛中，表面上也表现出正相反的态势。

en.t: In the tense atmosphere of the match, the Master and Otake, seventh dan, also seemed outwardly to display completely opposite attitudes.

units.source_text: 比如静与动，迟钝与敏捷。

en.t: For example, stillness and motion, slowness and agility.

units.source_text: 名人一埋头围棋，绝不上盥洗间。

en.t: Once the Master buried himself in the game of go, he would never go to the washroom.

units.source_text: 一般说，只要观察对弈者的表情和脸色，就大体能弄清棋势了。

en.t: Generally speaking, by observing the players' expressions and complexions, one can more or less grasp the state of the game.

units.source_text: 据说唯独名人难以摸透。

en.t: It was said that only the Master was difficult to read.

units.source_text: 七段的棋，反应并不敏捷，相反却表现出一种强劲的棋风。

en.t: The seventh dan's play was not quick in response; on the contrary, it showed a powerful style of go.

units.source_text: 他习惯长考，时间总是不够用。

en.t: He was accustomed to long reflection, and his allotted time was always insufficient.

units.source_text: 快到点了，记录员读秒，剩下一分钟，

en.t: When the time limit drew near, the recorder began counting down the seconds, and only one minute remained,

units.source_text: 他好像还有一百手，乃至一百五十手。

en.t: he seemed still to have a hundred moves, or even a hundred and fifty moves, left in him.

units.source_text: 这种时候，他气势磅礴，反而威胁了对手。

en.t: At such moments, his forceful presence swelled and instead intimidated his opponent.
